reviewMethod: Whole-target review of the frozen issue text, complete historical pull-request diff, implementation truth, focused-test truth, and explicit auxiliary truth.

targets.reason: The exception color-state fix and focused CliRunner assertions directly reproduce the issue.
The tempfile close-before-unlink change, regression test, and changelog all address the Windows cleanup error that masked the original exception.
The new Choice message hook, API documentation, changelog, and test form one feature-complete change.
Copying the completion argument slice prevents os.Args mutation, and the test reproduces the shared-backing-array failure.
The help command now receives the execution context and the focused test asserts identity of that context.
Default rendering is moved off text/template while preserving opt-in custom templates; dead-code elimination and inheritance tests cover the central behavior.
The accepted design names the option --ignore-contain instead of the issue's proposed --prune-parent, but CLI, config, traversal, docs, and tests all implement the same parent-tree pruning need.
The Windows file-URL authority slash fix, platform-aware assertion, and changelog directly address paths containing escaped characters.
The exact-match CLI option, anchored literal regex, documentation, conflict rules, and regression tests implement the requested non-substring behavior.
Setup-module invalidation is moved to the resolved module URL and the two-suite isolation-disabled reproduction verifies repeated hooks.
Captured stdio writers prevent later process stubbing from breaking the flush path, with a focused regression test for the hang.
Todo accounting, symbols, visibility rules, and reporter snapshots jointly preserve todo output while hiding skipped tests.
